name: hlavezzo-me-a11y-checks
description: Development and accessibility contracts for Henrique Lavezzo's Jekyll site; verification tooling is excluded from the generated site.

scripts.test:notebook-authorship: bundle exec jekyll build && node scripts/notebook-authorship.test.mjs

scripts.test:uses: bundle exec jekyll build && node scripts/uses.test.mjs

scripts.test:site-integrity: bundle exec jekyll build && node scripts/site-integrity.test.mjs
scripts.test:dark-cascade: npm run test:dark-contrast && npm run test:dark-literal-noop
scripts.test:4a: npm run test:manifest && npm run test:token-usage && npm run test:contrast && npm run test:projects-data && npm run test:motion && npm run test:dark-root-conflict && npm run test:dark-root-consolidation && npm run test:dead-class-detect && npm run test:legacy-cleanup
scripts.test:4b: npm run test:clamp && npm run test:text-spacing-height && npm run test:accessibility-page && npm run test:navigation && npm run test:laboratory && npm run test:notebook && npm run test:notebook-authorship && npm run test:notebook-evidence && npm run test:notebook-authoring-workflow && npm run test:notebook-preview && npm run test:about && npm run test:personal-facts && npm run test:letter && npm run test:now && npm run test:uses && npm run test:social-previews && npm run test:home-field-notes && npm run test:utility-pages && npm run test:site-integrity && npm run test:pa11y-contract
scripts.test:a11y-static: npm run test:4a && npm run test:4b
scripts.test:visual: bundle exec jekyll build && node scripts/visual-baseline.mjs
scripts.test:visual:update: bundle exec jekyll build && node scripts/visual-baseline.mjs --update
